summary: Both full halves inspected,with enlarged details of all original doubts and the formula instruction. The nested dollar signs in handwritten math macros are mechanical defects and are removed. The three inequalities have repeated regular typed bar/slash impressions,while the deltas are pen. The theorem ending is pen-retouched over typing. The first W-prefix,trivial,and weak are typed interlinear additions. The old aspheric remains partly obscured;the cancelled word below strict W reads local. The diagram equivalence sign and arrows are hand-drawn. The lower diagram index has a broad pointed top and base without a clean dot gap;independent second review agrees that ! versus star remains unresolved. A cancelled e-like impression above the n of section is restored. Remarks has a pen-retouched s. The cancelled contractibility fragment ends with an s. Of is legible beneath an uninterpreted curved pen stroke,now drawn. The mark after locas remains unreadable. The circled instruction formule a la ligne and the stepped brackets around h-prime are preserved;an exact reading variant puts that formula on its own line. The slash in on/page is retained diplomatically and supplied with a spacing variant. Final Fl forms retain the typed slash over l.

edits.reason: These handwritten delta macros occur inside existing math. Remove their nested dollar delimiters without changing any glyph or provenance.

All three inequalities have the same regular typed equal bars and slash impressions,contrasting with the nearby pen deltas. Retain them as plain typed composites;this also removes invalid nested math delimiters.
The pen em retouches already typed letters at the right edge. Preserve the visible underlying typed e/m forms rather than treating the ending as wholly added.
The W and hyphen are regular typed interlinear forms;the bracket into place is pen. The prefix remains joined to test.
The old l,o,c,a,l can be followed beneath the five x strikes under the typed replacement.
The TikZ-cd arrow label is already in math mode. Remove the redundant dollar pair while preserving all label content and its handwritten layer.

The index is a dark pointed form with a broad top and base and no clean separation of stem and dot. Both this inspection and an independent second reading leave shriek versus star unresolved;adjunction semantics are not used to force it.
A cancelled typed e-like impression is raised above the final n. It was omitted from the draft;its reading remains tentative.
The final s is retraced in pen over its typed outline.
Trivial is typed above the line,with a separate pen placement bracket.
The final old s is visible beneath the last x. The preceding strike occupies the gap after contractibility;literal xx was cancellation notation,not the cancelled text.
The typed o and f are readable. A separate curved pen stroke runs above and through the left side of o;preserve its geometry without interpreting it as a replacement letter.

The source formula is surrounded by stepped pen brackets connected to the nearby underlines. Preserve the formula and the visible brackets inline in the diplomatic source;the recorded reading variant applies the explicit line-placement instruction.
The handwritten instruction is enclosed in a large oval. Preserve the actual words and enclosure instead of omitting the circle.
Weak is typed interlinearly above equivalence and bracketed into place in pen.
The l has a regular typed slash superposed on it. Preserve both impressions as a literal overlay,without treating the slash as a deletion.
The second Fl repeats the typed l-plus-slash form. Preserve the same visible composite.
